body.label: Effect
body.html: Manifest the Beast's jaws or claws against one creature within 2 units. On a success, deal 1 Piercing damage.

surges.html: Increase this Action's range by 2 units. If you fully manifest through it, the manifestation also gains +1 Defense until your next turn.
Ignore 1 Defense granted by a supernatural effect.

rider.title: BEAST — FULL MANIFESTATION
rider.html: If you spent at least 4 dice on this Action, as it resolves you may spend 2 additional Mana to fully manifest your Beast.
